meta.description: Bach smart switch: modular metal keys in 14 custom colors, four lighting circuits, MixCtrl 2.0 keys with single and long press, Zigbee 3.0 and four layers of electrical protection.
meta.spec.description: Bach smart switch specifications: 4- and 8-key versions, metal key panels in 18 custom colors, 100–240 V AC, four lighting circuits up to 800 W each, Zigbee 3.0.
banner.name: Bach Smart Switch
banner.slogan: 300 years on, a minimalist homage to melodic beauty
sec2.bach_title:
A tribute to the classics
Minimal, rational beauty
sec2.bach_desc: Simplicity that masters complexity: every detail precise and refined, with the rational beauty of Bach's music.
sec3.bach_title:
An andante cantabile design
As exquisite as a work of art
sec3.bach_desc: Ganged side by side into one seamless, symmetrical whole, with detachable keys, frame and back box.
sec4.bach_title:
A structure as rigorous as mathematics
Raising the bar for smart switch design
sec4.bach_desc: Nine precisely built layers, each carefully checked. Impressive even when taken apart.
sec5.bach_title: Four levels of protection for electrical safety
sec5.desc:
[1] Based on ORVIBO lab tests (LED lamps with a 400 W load: relay life over 60,000 cycles, key life over 100,000 presses; at 10 switchings a day, 16.4 years). Actual results may vary with the materials and workmanship of different lamp brands.
[2] The industry average is 1 kV.
[3] This product has overload protection. Do not connect lamps or other loads (such as exhaust fans or bathroom heaters) above its rated power, or the product may be permanently damaged.
[4] Per the UL94 V-0 standard.
sec6.bach_desc: Minimal design and fine craftsmanship bring out the true feel of metal, in four exquisite colors that set the tone of any room.
spec.material: Material and colors: metal key panel, 18 custom colors
spec.voltage: Input voltage: 100–240 V AC, 50/60 Hz, live and neutral
spec.mounting: Mounting: standard 86 mm back box, can be ganged side by side
spec.load: Lighting load: 4 circuits, max 800 W per circuit, 1200 W in total
spec.loadTypes: Load types: incandescent, LED, energy-saving lamps and more
